answer: The V12-A structural gate, run by scripts/validate_v12.py, checks: valid strict frontmatter for every V12 document; uniqueness of volume, chapter and page identifiers; uniqueness of model, scenario, run and decision identifiers; that links resolve — every scenario model_id, every run model_id and scenario_id, every decision candidate run, and every pattern identifier and owner page in the existing registry; that every stored hash matches the current model or scenario file; that the reverse index is derived from the records rather than hand-edited; and the iron rule that no protected existing page or card outside the V12 directory references V12 paths or V12-only identifiers.
